title: Exact Accepted Bottom Interface Exchange Result Warning-Hygiene Remediation

blocker.finding: F-GC21P1 replaced two pre-existing REAL equality checks by paired <= and >= comparisons solely to satisfy a global -Werror/-Wcompare-reals qualification policy. That production delta is outside the preregistered exact accepted bottom-exchange result scope and is not admitted as semantically identity-preserving for all IEEE behavior.

production: Restore the two affected interval identity predicates exactly to the canonical equality form.
Preserve every F-GC21P1 bottom_outward_exchange_native transport and accumulation change unchanged.
qualification: Keep warnings fatal except that the pre-existing compare-reals warning class may be non-fatal for the restored canonical equality predicates.
Prove the restored predicates match the current-canonical baseline and that F-GC21P1 adds no new compare-real predicate outside those baseline locations.
Re-run owner qualification at O0 and O2 on the corrected production state.

hard_constraints: No mass-balance tolerance or numerical workaround.
No change to accepted-exchange sign, units, accumulation, retry, two-half, commit or fallback semantics.
No MODFLOW-specific semantics or production-coupling admission claim.
No independent qualification or canonical-admission claim in this work unit.
No change to RB1 or closed F-CI54 authority.
Fail closed if warning hygiene cannot be isolated without broadening production scope.
